title: Final Heat Flow Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the equation for the rate of heat flow, Q_dot.

title: Final Temperature Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the temperature at the midpoint of the wire, T_C.

title: Heat Flow Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should show the correct reasoning and steps leading to the heat flow equation, including the integration process.

title: Temperature Gradient Application
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply the temperature gradient correctly in the context of the varying radius.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes when calculating Q_dot and T_C.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit any factors related to the geometry of the wire in their calculations.
